-- Extend conversations table
ALTER TABLE conversations 
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS isStarred TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS workflowStatus ENUM('active','paused','completed','none') DEFAULT 'none',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS workflowName VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS channelSummary VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS unreadCount INT DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS contactId INT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS lastActivityAt DATETIME NULL;

-- Extend conversation_messages table  
ALTER TABLE conversation_messages
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS type ENUM('sms_in','sms_out','email_in','email_out','call','note','system','workflow') DEFAULT 'sms_out',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subject VARCHAR(500) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS actor VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata JSON NULL;
